title: Crash Landing on You
description: A South Korean heiress accidentally paraglides into North Korea and falls in love with a military officer who shields her identity.
story: Yoon Se-ri, a successful businesswoman and heiress, is paragliding when a sudden storm forces her to land in North Korea. There she meets Captain Ri Jeong-hyeok, a stoic military officer who decides to help hide her. As the two spend more time together, they fall deeply in love. The drama explores the hardships of a relationship divided by borders, ideology, and impossible circumstances, all while maintaining a warm and often humorous tone.

cast.name: Son Ye-jin

title: Goblin
description: An immortal Goblin seeks his human bride to end his eternal life, but falls in love with her instead.
story: Kim Shin is a decorated military general from the Goryeo dynasty who was cursed to live as an immortal Goblin. The only way to end his immortal life is to find his human bride who can pull the sword from his chest. He meets Ji Eun-tak, a bubbly high school student with the ability to see ghosts, who is destined to be his bride. As their love grows, both must face the consequences of fate and sacrifice.

cast.name: Gong Yoo

cast.name: Kim Go-eun
cast.bio: South Korean actress born July 2, 1991 in Seoul. Goblin was one of her breakout television roles, launching her as a leading actress in Korean drama.

cast.name: Lee Dong-wook

cast.name: Yoo In-na

title: Itaewon Class
description: An ex-convict opens a small bar in Itaewon and fights against a powerful food conglomerate that destroyed his family.
story: Park Saeroyi's life is shattered when his father is killed in a hit-and-run by the son of a powerful food company CEO. After serving time in prison for assaulting the culprit, Saeroyi vows revenge — not through violence, but by building a thriving business empire to outcompete the conglomerate. With the help of a sharp-tongued manager, Jo Yi-seo, and a loyal crew of misfits, he embarks on a journey of grit, ambition, and justice.

title: My Love from the Star
description: An alien who has lived on Earth for 400 years falls in love with a top actress just before he must return to his home planet.
story: Do Min-joon is an alien who landed on Earth during the Joseon dynasty and has been living as a human ever since. With supernatural abilities and an appearance that never ages, he works as a law professor. He meets Cheon Song-yi, the nation's biggest celebrity, who moves into his apartment building. Despite his desire to keep his distance, Min-joon finds himself falling for her — even as the clock ticks on his imminent departure from Earth.

title: Scarlet Heart: Ryeo
description: A modern woman travels back in time to the Goryeo dynasty and becomes entangled in a power struggle among princes.
story: Go Ha-jin, a contemporary woman, is transported back in time to the Goryeo dynasty where she wakes up in the body of a noble girl named Hae Soo. Surrounded by the many princes of the ruling Wang family, she must navigate dangerous court politics, royal rivalries, and the pain of knowing history's cruel outcomes. She falls deeply in love with the brooding fourth prince, Wang So, but destiny may not allow them a happy ending.

description: Two cultivators investigate a series of mysterious dark arts crimes that shake the martial world and uncover a conspiracy buried in the past.
story: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji are two young men from rival cultivation clans who meet and develop an unlikely bond while pursuing a shared goal of justice. After a tragedy leads to Wei Wuxian's apparent death, he is resurrected sixteen years later in the body of another man. Together, they investigate a series of supernatural murders that lead back to long-buried secrets and a powerful, ancient evil that threatens the entire cultivation world.

description: A beautiful computer science student and a top gamer meet in an online game and their in-game romance spills into real life.

She is approached by Xiao Nai, the most sought-after student on campus and also the best player in the game, to become his in-game wife. description: The epic story of Ertuğrul, father of Ottoman Empire founder Osman I, and his tribe's fight for survival and justice.

Their relationship is opposed by her family and further complicated by Emir, a powerful and manipulative man who is determined to keep Nihan for himself. The series is a dramatic, intense portrayal of love, sacrifice, and the destructive power of obsession.

title: Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne?
description: A young woman's fight for justice after a horrific crime changes her life and challenges the society around her.
story: Fatmagül is a simple, kind-hearted young woman living in a small Turkish town on the Aegean coast, about to be married to her childhood sweetheart. Her life is shattered when she becomes the victim of a violent assault committed by a group of wealthy young men. The series follows her long, painful battle for justice in a society quick to blame the victim, and her unexpected bond with Kerim, one of the perpetrators who was coerced into participating.

title: It's Okay to Not Be Okay
description: A psychiatric ward caregiver and a antisocial children's book author heal each other's emotional wounds.
story: Moon Gang-tae, who cares for his autistic older brother while working at a psychiatric hospital, crosses paths with Ko Moon-young, a successful but emotionally guarded children's book author, and the two begin to heal each other's deep-rooted trauma.

title: Reply 1988
description: Five childhood friends and their families navigate life, love, and growing up in 1980s Seoul.
story: Set in a close-knit Seoul neighborhood in 1988, five friends grow up together through school, first loves, and family struggles, in a nostalgic look at friendship and coming of age.

story: After enduring horrific bullying in high school that left her scarred for life, Moon Dong-eun spends years carefully orchestrating an elaborate revenge plan against her former tormentors.

title: Twenty-Five Twenty-One

story: Amid South Korea's 1997 financial crisis, aspiring fencer Na Hee-do fights to keep her Olympic dream alive while forming a deep connection with Baek Yi-jin, a young man whose family fortune collapsed overnight.

title: Descendants of the Sun
description: A special forces captain and a surgeon fall in love while navigating duty, danger, and disaster relief abroad.
story: Captain Yoo Si-jin of a special forces unit and surgeon Kang Mo-yeon reconnect on a humanitarian mission overseas, where their romance is tested by military duty, natural disasters, and personal sacrifice.

title: Start-Up

story: Seo Dal-mi dreams of becoming an entrepreneur and reconnects with a childhood pen pal, only to find her path intertwined with two young men - one pretending to be that pen pal - as they all build startups in a competitive tech incubator.

title: Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-joo
description: A college weightlifter navigates friendship, ambition, and an unexpected romance with a competitive swimmer.
story: Kim Bok-joo, a talented but insecure weightlifter at a sports university, grows in confidence both in and out of the gym as she falls for her childhood friend, a swimmer chasing his own Olympic dream.
